name: butterfly_meridian
theme: a monarch migration at golden hour — down a milkweed stand into one monarch's wing, through the structural-colour gyroid labyrinth inside a single wing scale, out along ribbons of stars to the Butterfly nebula, and home down a violet dusk planet's golden rivers to the same valley

registers.name: valley_meadow
registers.scene: a wide hillside meadow at golden hour seen from the slope at eye level among tall grass and wildflowers, the whole valley open below and the low sun beyond, the warm air over the valley thick with countless small orange and black monarch butterflies, a stand of milkweed further down the slope
registers.target: a stand of milkweed, thick green stems topped with round crowns of small pink flowers
registers.loop_target: the sunlit hillside meadow at golden hour, tall grass and wildflowers on the slope, the warm valley air over it full of small orange monarch wings

registers.name: milkweed_stand
registers.scene: a stand of milkweed on the open hillside at golden hour, thick green stems and broad ribbed leaves, round crowns of small pink flowers at the top, warm light through the leaf edges, tall grass and the valley slope beyond, monarch butterflies at rest on several of the blooms
registers.target: a monarch butterfly, wings held open and flat, deep orange panes divided by heavy black veins

registers.name: monarch
registers.scene: a monarch butterfly at rest on a broad green leaf, both wings held open and flat, deep orange panes divided by heavy black veins, a black border set with white dots around the outer edge
registers.target: a long triangular forewing, an orange pane framed in thick black veins

registers.name: wing_scales
registers.scene: the tiled country of a monarch wing surface, flat scale tiles overlapping in neat ranks, wide bands of orange tiles beside bands of black tiles, a heavy black vein ridge crossing them beyond, every tile ridged along its length, a faint violet sheen at the tile edges
registers.target: an orange scale tile, a flat elongated plate with fine parallel ridges

registers.name: scale_tile
registers.scene: a single wing scale among its overlapping neighbours, a flat elongated orange plate ribbed with fine parallel ridges from base to tip, slender cross-struts bridging the ridges, the outer edge notched into blunt teeth, more plates ranked behind it
registers.target: a dark narrow slot, a violet-rimmed opening

registers.name: gyroid
registers.scene: a gyroid labyrinth deep inside the wing scale, smooth curved walls folding through three directions in an endless minimal-surface maze, wide open channels between them, three-way junctions repeating away in every direction, the walls shot with violet and orange iridescence

registers.name: star_ribbons
registers.scene: deep space threaded by long looping ribbons of stars, two great luminous coils crossing at the center of the void, fine dust lanes curving along each ribbon, warm amber starlight strewn through the black
registers.target: a bright two-lobed nebula, a brilliant white core between two glowing lobes

registers.name: butterfly_nebula
registers.scene: an enormous planetary nebula spread through the void, two vast symmetric lobes of glowing gas spread on either side of a brilliant white core, fine orange and violet filaments veining each lobe, a dark dust band across the waist between them
registers.target: a deep violet planet, a dark dusk hemisphere and a thin bright limb

registers.name: dusk_planet
registers.scene: a great violet planet seen close from space, its curved limb bright against the black, deep purple land under a thin violet haze, networks of branching golden rivers spread across the dark surface
registers.target: a wide golden river, a broad braided channel with smaller branches

registers.name: valley_aerial
registers.scene: a broad river valley at golden hour seen from high above, a wide golden river winding between green hillsides, meadows and hedgerows and small stands of trees over the slopes, low warm light across the whole valley

music_theme: a monarch migration over a golden-hour valley, warm and soaring, wide strings and soft bells over a low drone, one bright shimmering bloom landing on the wing-scale-to-starfield seam
